from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework import viewsets, status
from rest_framework.decorators import action
from rest_framework.response import Response
from modules.cms.models import Complaint, ComplaintFeedback, ComplaintAnnouncement, CmsRoleAssignment
from modules.cms.serializers import ComplaintSerializer, ComplaintFeedbackSerializer, ComplaintAnnouncementSerializer, CmsRoleAssignmentSerializer
from modules.users.models import User
from modules.users.permissions import IsHandler, IsSupervisor, IsAdmin

class ComplaintViewSet(viewsets.ModelViewSet):
    queryset = Complaint.objects.all()
    serializer_class = ComplaintSerializer
    permission_classes = [IsHandler | IsSupervisor | IsAdmin]

    def get_queryset(self):
        user = self.request.user
        if user.role == 'admin' or user.role == 'supervisor':
            return Complaint.objects.all()
        return Complaint.objects.filter(complainant_user_id=user.id)

    def perform_create(self, serializer):
        user = self.request.user
        serializer.save(complainant_user_id=user)
        complaint_id = f"CMS-2026-{serializer.instance.id}"
        serializer.instance.complaint_id = complaint_id
        serializer.save()

    @action(detail=True, methods=['post'])
    def assign(self, request, pk=None):
        complaint = self.get_object()
        complaint.assigned_handler_id = request.data.get('assigned_handler_id')
        complaint.category = request.data.get('category')
        complaint.priority = request.data.get('priority')
        sla_due_date = timezone.now() + timezone.timedelta(days=int(request.data.get('priority')))
        complaint.sla_due_date = sla_due_date
        complaint.status = 'Assigned'
        complaint.save()
        return Response(status=status.HTTP_200_OK)
